verdict.rationale: Pigment's budget-planning page claims variance analysis in the same platform as the budget and says it helps users "understand and flag the reasons behind identified gaps." The Analyst Agent is said to monitor the business and uncover what matters. It is unclear whether the platform itself generates explanations or whether users annotate the reasons. Missing for 10: documentation of automated driver or root-cause decomposition for budget-to-actual and period-over-period variances, examples of the explanations produced, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, the platform explains a budget-to-actual or period-over-period variance rather than only flagging it

citations.quote: Run variance analysis on the same platform you build your budget. Understand and flag the reasons behind identified gaps
The Analyst Agent continuously monitors your business, uncovers what matters and builds reports from simple conversations
